Chief of Staff / Executive Assistant (Remote) About 16VC 16VC is an early-stage venture capital firm backing ambitious founders building the future across AI, SaaS, fintech, deep tech, consumer, and enterprise technology. Beyond investing, we work closely with founders through our platform, community, and venture studio initiatives.

We're looking for a highly organized, proactive, and resourceful Chief of Staff / Executive Assistant to work closely with the Founding Partner. This is a high-impact remote role that blends executive support, operations, project management, and strategic coordination.

If you enjoy solving problems, keeping teams organized, and making things happen behind the scenes, we'd love to hear from you. About the Role You'll be the operational backbone of 16VC , ensuring the leadership team can focus on investing, founders, and building the firm.

You'll manage priorities, coordinate across internal and external stakeholders, and help execute strategic initiatives across multiple time zones. This is a fully remote position . We value clear communication, ownership, and the ability to work independently while collaborating with a distributed team. No two days will be the same.

What You'll Do Executive Support Manage the Founding Partner's calendar, meetings, travel, and priorities. Prepare agendas, meeting notes, and follow-up action items. Coordinate investor, founder, and partner meetings across time zones. Handle confidential correspondence and communications. Operations Improve internal processes and documentation.

Coordinate day-to-day business operations in a remote-first environment. Manage vendors, subscriptions, and operational tools. Support hiring, onboarding, and internal administration. Project Management Track strategic initiatives across investing, platform, and 16VC Labs. Ensure projects move forward and deadlines are met.

Coordinate with internal teams, founders, and external partners. Maintain dashboards, trackers, and operating documents. Investor & Founder Coordination Schedule founder meetings and investment committee sessions. Assist with LP updates and reporting. Coordinate portfolio communications.

Help organize virtual and in-person founder events, demo days, and community programs. Research & Special Projects Conduct market and ecosystem research. Prepare presentations, reports, and briefing documents. Support new initiatives and partnerships. Take ownership of ad hoc projects from idea to execution.

What We're Looking For 2–6 years of experience as a Chief of Staff, Executive Assistant, Program Manager, Operations Manager, or similar role. Exceptional organizational and time management skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced remote environment.

High attention to detail and strong follow-through. Comfortable handling confidential information with discretion. Self-starter with a proactive, ownership mindset. Comfortable collaborating across different time zones and using remote communication tools.

Tools You'll Likely Use Google Workspace Microsoft Office Notion Slack Zoom Calendar and scheduling tools Airtable or similar databases AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini Nice to Have Experience working at a startup, venture capital firm, accelerator, or founder's office. Project management experience. Event coordination experience.

Familiarity with venture capital, fundraising, or startup ecosystems. Experience using productivity and AI tools to automate workflows. Experience working with distributed or remote teams. Why Join 16VC Work directly with the Founding Partner and leadership team. Enjoy the flexibility of a fully remote work environment.

Gain exposure to startups, venture capital, and emerging technologies. High ownership with opportunities to influence how the firm operates. Build relationships with exceptional founders, investors, and operators worldwide. Be part of building a modern venture capital firm from the ground up.

Who You'll Thrive As You're someone who enjoys bringing order to complexity. You anticipate needs before they're asked, communicate clearly, and take pride in making teams more effective. Whether it's coordinating a board meeting, organizing a founder event, or keeping strategic projects on track, you're the person who gets things done.

You thrive in a remote-first environment, communicate proactively, and take ownership without needing constant direction. Originally posted on Himalayas

About the Role As a Bilingual Medical Virtual Assistant, you will help keep patient and administrative workflows organized from intake through documentation and follow-up.

You will communicate with English- and Spanish-speaking patients, including patients referred by law firms, while coordinating appointments, referrals, medical records, and attorney requests.

You will also review and clean AI-generated medical notes, making this a strong opportunity for someone who combines healthcare experience with curiosity about emerging technology. This role offers meaningful autonomy and is best suited to someone who thinks critically, solves problems proactively, and can adapt as workflows evolve.

Responsibilities Manage patient intake and ensure demographic, insurance, referral, and case information is complete and accurate Schedule, confirm, and coordinate patient appointments while maintaining clear communication with patients and the clinical team Communicate professionally in English and Spanish with patients, law firm representatives, attorneys, and healthcare partners Support patients referred by law firms by tracking documentation, appointments, and required follow-up Review and clean AI-generated medical notes for clarity, formatting, completeness, and obvious inconsistencies before final review Prepare and coordinate medical referrals, ensuring supporting records and documentation are included Send requested medical documentation and case updates to attorneys through approved communication channels Maintain accurate, organized, and current patient records within the Electronic Health Records system Use Gmail, Google Drive, Google Chat, Google Meet, and other Google Workspace tools to manage communication and documentation Identify workflow gaps and recommend practical improvements that reduce errors, delays, or repetitive administrative work Requirements Must-Have: Full professional fluency in English and Spanish, both written and spoken Experience supporting a U.S. medical practice or healthcare provider Hands-on experience with patient scheduling, intake, referrals, and medical documentation Confidence using Electronic Health Records systems Strong computer skills and experience with Google Workspace, including Gmail, Drive, Chat, and Meet Excellent organization, written communication, and attention to detail Availability to work Monday through Friday during Pacific Standard Time business hours Nice to Have: Experience supporting a neurology, personal injury, legal-medical, or specialist healthcare practice Experience communicating with attorneys, law firms, or patients involved in legal cases Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude Experience reviewing AI-generated notes, transcripts, or clinical documentation A track record of improving administrative processes or creating more efficient workflows Benefits Access to a $200K+ perk marketplace with discounts on 150+ global services.

Position Overview: At Ready Roles, we don’t just fill positions; we build lasting, impactful careers. As a Remote Executive Assistant, you will step into a critical role as a trusted “right arm” for an American business owner, making an essential difference in their day-to-day and long-term success.

We are looking for driven, proactive individuals who don’t wait for instructions but actively seek opportunities to make an impact. This role is for self-starters who thrive on finding solutions, tackling new challenges, and staying one step ahead of the business owner’s needs.

Ready Roles carefully vets every client to ensure a respectful, growth-oriented work environment where your contributions are valued. We’re looking for someone ready to build a future, grow their skills, and commit to long-term success with their client. Why Join Ready Roles?

A Career Path, Not Just a Job: This isn’t a stepping-stone; it’s a role designed for long-term growth. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to build a stable career with a supportive company that invests in their future.

Independence and Opportunity to Lead: Our clients want self-driven assistants who identify opportunities for improvement, find ways to make the business run smoothly, and drive the organization forward without needing to be told what to do. You’ll actively manage the business owner’s schedule and push organizational goals, not just your own tasks.

Respectful, Growth-Focused Clients: We only partner with clients who value stability and respect for their team. As a Ready Role, you’ll work with a business owner who is committed to your success and who shares a long-term vision for growth. Key Responsibilities: 1.

Daily Management and Proactive Support: Calendar and Schedule Management: Oversee and prioritize the CEO’s calendar, blocking time for high-priority tasks, scheduling meetings, and ensuring the CEO is fully prepared for each day.

Email and Communication Oversight: Sort, prioritize, and respond to emails and messages, filtering essential information to keep the CEO focused and eliminating routine communication distractions.

Daily Check-Ins and Task Planning: Conduct a daily check-in with the CEO to review priorities, set action items, and address any immediate needs, keeping both the CEO and the team on track. 2.

Self-Directed Task Identification: Identify Areas to Add Value: Proactively seek out tasks or projects that align with business goals, whether improving internal processes, coordinating with team members, or streamlining workflows.

Manage and Anticipate Owner’s Needs: Track ongoing projects, follow up on open items, and keep the CEO informed on key updates and deadlines without needing reminders ￼. 3. Invoicing & Accounts Support
Send out invoices promptly and accurately
Monitor invoice status and ensure payments are received
Follow up on unpaid invoices (e.g., after 1 week)
Maintain detailed and organized invoicing records with clear notes (e.g., date sent, follow-ups required)
Assist with tracking company expenses and maintaining financial spreadsheets
What We’re Looking For: Self-Driven, Proactive Mindset - This role is for someone who naturally takes the initiative and actively finds ways to contribute. You’ll be expected to add value without waiting for instructions and to be a driving force for the business. Commitment to Long-Term Growth - Ready Roles is built on loyalty and stability.

We’re looking for someone who values a long-term commitment, seeks stability, and is motivated to build a future with us and the business owner they support. Aligned with Our Values - Ready Roles believes in accountability, respect, and integrity.

We’re looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, consistently shows up with purpose, and is eager to create a lasting impact.

Qualifications: Must be based in the Philippines Must have basic accounting (invoicing) knowledge and experience Must know how to utilize QuickBooks 18 years old and above Willing to work from home with a stable internet connection Must have own equipment — reliable laptop or PC and a noise-cancelling headset Available to work full-time (40 hours per week) Leadership Potential and Vision: Prior experience managing remote tasks or supporting a business owner is a plus, but we’re most interested in candidates ready to take ownership, lead by example, and actively shape the future of their role.

Resourceful and Solution-Oriented: You’ll look for ways to make the business owner’s day-to-day run smoothly, identifying gaps, solving problems, and proactively contributing to long-term growth.

Strong Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills to maintain consistent, professional interactions with the business owner, team members, and clients. Growth-Minded and Self-Motivated: If you’re looking for a career where you can make an impact and build something lasting, Ready Roles is the place for you.

This role is designed for someone who sees this as more than just a job—a chance to lead, grow, and secure their future. Apply Today If you’re ready to commit, lead, and build a career with purpose, stability, and growth, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today to join Ready Roles and start building a future where your work drives real impact, stability, and lasting success. Originally posted on Himalayas

About Agicap
Created in Lyon in 2016 by three French entrepreneurs, Agicap is one of the fastest scale-ups in Europe, with over 8000 customers, 650 employees and fast revenue growth (7x between 2021 and 2024). Agicap is part of the French Tech 120, rewarding the most promising startups in France.
Agicap allows Finance teams of Mid-Market companies to efficiently manage and forecast their cash, pay their suppliers and get paid. By combining a Treasury Management System, and Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable solutions into a single platform, Agicap aims at becoming the next leading Treasury Management platform for mid-market companies.
We have raised €145M since our creation, with prestigious VC funds including AVP, Greenoaks, Partech and BlackFin, with a last round in November 2024.
These additional resources further fuel our product innovation, allowing us to grow significantly and accelerate our international expansion across the world.
We believe our success comes from our highly passionate and dedicated teams, committed to building a company where people can grow and build their careers. We are constantly looking for great talents, aiming for excellence and ready to join our ambitious adventure!
Tasks

1. Office operations
Ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the office (supplies, equipment, maintenance, badge access).
Be the main point of contact with the space provider (coworking / landlord).
Ensure compliance with fire safety and local regulatory obligations.
Monitor office occupancy trends and anticipate future space needs.
Manage the relationship with building- and equipment-related vendors (cleaning, security, maintenance).
Ensure the office quality meets Agicap's standards.
2. Office life and employee experience
Organize team events and initiatives that foster cohesion and employee engagement.
Manage employee services (snacks, drinks, amenities, small orders).
Act as the local point of contact for the needs and feedback of the German team.
3. Onboarding / Offboarding
Prepare the arrival of new joiners (workstation, equipment, welcome pack).
Support departing employees (administrative and logistical offboarding).
4. Administrative support and local compliance
Provide first-level support on administrative matters (supplier contracts, invoices, expense reports).
Contribute to monitoring local legal obligations, working with the Legal, Finance, and HR teams at headquarters.
5. Reporting and coordination
Provide regular reporting to the manager on activity and ongoing topics.
Take part in Office Management team meetings and contribute to sharing best practices across offices.
Monitor the Berlin office's operating budget.

Native or fluent German, with professional-level English required to communicate with the manager and colleagues.
Proven experience in a similar role (office management, administrative coordination, facilities) within an international
environment.
Strong sense of organization, autonomy, and rigor, with the ability to manage a wide range of information.
Good interpersonal skills, service-oriented mindset, and ability to work in a multicultural environment.
Flexibility and pragmatism, comfortable switching between different tasks.
Contract type: Permanent contract - 50% - 4h/day – Monday to Friday

Competitive Compensation: Attractive package including both fixed and variable components.
Prime Office Location: Work from a large, modern office at Moritzplatz (Berlin) featuring a large terrace, snacks, and drinks.
Professional Development: Access a “Mini-MBA” with a focus on Finance & Treasury via the Agicap Academy.
Global Collaboration: Join a diverse international team with regular events in Berlin and occasional trips to our headquarters in France.

Tenure Rewards: Enjoy a €30 monthly shopping voucher after one year and up to two additional vacation days based on your length of service.
Team Culture: Be part of a dynamic environment with global offsites (like our recent annual seminar in the South of France) and local team events.
Agicap is committed to providing equal opportunities for everyone, and we foster an inclusive work environment that values diversity!

To qualify for this position, applicants must meet all requirements by the closing date of this announcement, 08/13/2026. Time-In-Grade Requirement: Applicants who are current Federal employees and have held a GS grade any time in the past 52 weeks must also meet time-in-grade requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

For a GS-07 position you must have served 52 weeks at the GS-06. The grade may have been in any occupation, but must have been held in the Federal service. An SF-50 that shows your time-in-grade eligibility must be submitted with your application materials.

If the most recent SF-50 has an effective date within the past year, it may not clearly demonstrate you possess one-year time-in-grade, as required by the announcement. In this instance, you must provide an additional SF-50 that clearly demonstrates one-year time-in-grade.

Note: Time-In-Grade requirements also apply to former Federal employees applying for reinstatement as well as current employees applying for Veterans Employment Opportunities Act of 1998 (VEOA) appointment.

You may qualify based on your experience as described below: Specialized Experience: You must have one year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade GS-06 in the normal line of progression for the occupation in the organization.

Cerchiamo una persona proattiva, organizzata e dotata di spiccata capacità relazionale, in grado di affiancare la Capo Area e di contribuire concretamente al buon funzionamento dell-area e dei relativi centri di competenza. Inserita in un contesto dinamico e trasversale, assumerà un ruolo di riferimento nel coordinamento delle attività, nella gestione dei flussi informativi e nella preparazione della documentazione necessaria ai processi decisionali.
La persona che cerchiamo sa lavorare con autonomia e spirito collaborativo, gestendo contemporaneamente più attività, definendo correttamente le priorità e adattandosi con flessibilità alle diverse esigenze. Possiede un forte senso di responsabilità e comunica in modo chiaro ed efficace con interlocutori di diverso livello, garantendo discrezione, affidabilità e riservatezza nella gestione delle informazioni sensibili.
**La persona dovrà essere in grado di:**
* affiancare la Capo Area e i centri di competenza nella parte più organizzativa garantendo efficienza ai processi lavorativi
* collaborare attivamente con i diversi servizi e con gli interlocutori interni ed esterni alla direzione generale e a EOC, fornendo supporto trasversale.
* gestire con autonomia incarichi specifici, pendenze e scadenze, individuando priorità e anticipando le esigenze operative e organizzative dell-Area.
* predisporre presentazioni, rapporti, sintesi, assicurando chiarezza, accuratezza e qualità dei contenuti**;**
* gestire la corrispondenza e le comunicazioni, assicurando un flusso informativo strutturato ed efficace tra i diversi interlocutori, adattando la comunicazione a dipendenza dell-interlocutore.
* coordinare riunioni e incontri, occupandosi della pianificazione, della preparazione della documentazione, della verbalizzazione e del monitoraggio delle decisioni e delle relative pendenze.
* svolgere le attività amministrative di competenza, predisponendo e gestendo mediante gli strumenti informatici disponibili, la documentazione necessaria (corrispondenza, verbali, report e altri documenti) garantendone la corretta archiviazione;
* contribuire alla realizzazione di progetti e iniziative trasversali, assumendo ulteriori incarichi in funzione dell-evoluzione delle esigenze dell-area.
## Requisiti necessari: ##
* Attestato federale di capacità quale impiegato/a di commercio (o titolo equivalente) e/o superiore;
* ottima conoscenza dell-italiano e buone conoscenze del tedesco e dell-inglese;
* ottima padronanza dei principali strumenti informatici e digitali (pacchetto Office);
* formazione in qualità di Assistente di Direzione costituirà titolo preferenziale
* capacità di operare in modo autonomo, strutturato e orientato alle soluzioni, gestendo efficacemente priorità e scadenze;
* esperienza pregressa in posizione analoga costituirà titolo preferenziale;
* capacità relazionali e comunicative, capacità di mediazione;
* elevato senso di responsabilità, discrezione e confidenzialità nella gestione delle informazioni;
* flessibilità, spirito di iniziativa e orientamento al cambiamento continuo.
